snippet.title: Elsewhere Battles Is Here | iPhone & iPad Strategy
snippet.description:
Elsewhere Battles has arrived! 🏰⚔️

Put villagers to work, grow your settlement and lead your armies against strange rivals in our turn-based fantasy strategy game.

Now available on the U.S. App Store for iPhone and iPad. Free to download with optional permanent purchases.

Search Elsewhere Battles in the U.S. App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/elsewhere-battles/id6826332316

🎵 Moonbound Remix
Gameplay sped up 1.5×; construction shown across turns. Some civilizations and remix music shown require purchases.

#ElsewhereBattles #TurnBasedStrategy #IndieGame
